about: Size and SHA-256 of every game-data file of the reference SM3 Studio installation (2026-10-08),
the one the tool was developed and tested with. tools/extraire_donnees_jeu.py checks the files
it rebuilds from the player's game against this list. A fingerprint does not contain any game data.
extracted   : rebuilt from the player's Spider-Man 3 packs by tools/extraire_donnees_jeu.py
distributed : our own measurements (numbers, hashes), shipped with SM3 Studio
optional    : Spider-Man: Web of Shadows data, never extracted (Web of Shadows mode off without it)
Not listed  : profiles/venom/Venom_editable.blend(1), Blender files, not byte-reproducible
